name: Brighthill Lodge
source:
Hello, welcome to Brighthill Lodge!

Follow our main character on a delightful winter vacation, set in a cozy ski lodge deep in the mountains!

Explore the beautiful surrounding forest, relax in world-renowned hot springs or take to the ski slopes, all the while growing closer to our diverse cast of characters!

[From [url=https://packrat-entertainment.itch.io/brighthill-lodge]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你好，欢迎来到布莱特希尔旅馆！

跟随我们的主角，在大山深处舒适的滑雪小屋里度过一个愉快的寒假！

探索周围美丽的森林，在世界著名的温泉中放松身心或去滑雪场，同时与我们多样化的角色更加亲密！

[来自[url=https://packrat-entertainment.itch.io/brighthill-lodge]Itch.io[/url]]
